headline: Arsenal 2-0 at Sunderland: four from four, Guimaraes then Saka
whyCareReason: The champions go to a promoted ground and leave with 12 points. Nobody else has a perfect record except City.
teaser: Guimaraes 58', Saka 90+7' penalty. Sunderland 0-2 Arsenal. Arsenal 8-1 on goal difference.
story:
Why this one matters: matchweek 4 was the first chance the table had to apologise. Arsenal did not let it. Sunderland 0-2 Arsenal, Bruno Guimaraes 58', Bukayo Saka 90+7' penalty, per Football Web Pages.

AFP after Sunday: Arsenal 4 4 0 0, 8 1, 12 points. Same line on Squawka and NBC Sports. City also have 12 after Old Trafford. Goal difference is the split: Arsenal +7, City +6.

A promoted club hosted the champions. The champions left with the same 100 per cent they brought.
stakes: Twelve points from four. A title start that now has a road win in it.
rivalryAngle: Promoted host, champion guest, one result.
